title: Can barely cut butter.
text: Can barely cut butter.. Aledy Large Butter Dish with Lid, Airtight Large Butter Keeper with with Cutting Net and Sealing Cover, Butter Container. From the picture it looks so easy with two fingers pushing down on the butter and cutting those nice little pads. When I first took the butter out and tried to cut it was a fight. I thought I would wait for about an hour and tried to cut it again, but it still was not happening. I waited for about 2 hours and figured that the better  must be soft by now and pushed it down with both hands and rubbed across the top and you can see by the pictures what happened. It did eventually cut the butter pads, but they were not nice and pretty like the picture. So, as you can see, I can only give it a 3.  OZ
